name: Incode
description: Incode is an Italian creative studio specialising in full-stack development, UX/UI design, websites, e-commerce and custom digital products. Based in Cremona and Asola (Mantua), Italy.
descriptionShort: Italian creative studio for full-stack development, UX/UI, websites and custom digital products.

services.name: Websites & E-commerce
services.description: Design and development of websites and online stores with WordPress, WooCommerce, Drupal and Shopify.

services.name: Custom software projects
services.description: Custom full-stack applications with Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Vue.js, architecture and system integration.

services.name: UX & UI
services.description: User experience and interface design, evaluation, assessment and consulting.
